block_as_test_object_on_inclined_plane: A block is an object that can be moved onto an inclined plane to test friction.
inclined_plane_has_surface_material: An inclined plane has a surface material that can be known or unknown.
polarized_component_has_anode_cathode: A polarized electrical component has an anode and a cathode that can be connected to wires.
wire_has_two_terminals: A wire is an electrical component with terminal 1 and terminal 2 that can be connected to other components.

already_connected_prevents_reconnection: Attempting to connect an already connected terminal fails with a message that it must be disconnected first.
broken_device_not_activatable: A device that is broken cannot be activated or deactivated; attempts to do so fail with a message that it is broken.
component_not_directly_activatable: A component that is not directly activatable cannot be activated; attempts to activate it fail with a message that it is not something that can be activated.
container_open_state: After opening a container, the feedback explicitly states that the container is now open; subsequent attempts to open it yield that it is already open.
object_position_on_inclined_plane: An object on an inclined plane has a position described as a percentage down the plane or at the top of the plane.

connect_components: Connecting two components updates their connection state.
focus_on_object: Focusing on an object produces feedback confirming the focus.
measure_temperature: Using a thermometer on a substance yields a temperature reading.
mix_ingredients_produces_target: Mixing the required ingredients in a container produces the target substance.
move_object_to_appliance: Moving an object to an appliance places it on or in that appliance.
move_object_to_container: Moving an object to a container places the object inside that container.
open_container: Opening a closed container changes its state to open.
pick_up_to_inventory: Picking up an object moves it to the inventory.
pour_transfers_contents: Pouring the contents of one container into another transfers the contents.
seed_grows_after_watering_and_waiting: After planting a seed in a flower pot and pouring water, waiting results in a plant in a later growth stage.
wait_causes_slide_down_plane: Waiting after placing an object on an inclined plane causes the object to slide further down the plane.

conditional_prerequisites.condition: When the public task specifies above/below temperature destinations and a public thermometer reading is observed, choose the destination matching that reading and task threshold.
conditional_prerequisites.name: measured_temperature_selects_public_task_destination

recovery_policies.name: ambiguous_request_numbered_selection
recovery_policies.policy: When a command is ambiguous because multiple objects match, the system prompts with numbered options; entering the number selects the intended action.

evidence_policies: Domain rules require literal public train evidence from at least two episodes; each MetaOp field requires independent literal Skill evidence.
